scenarios.title: 2651 mapping under 2003 snapshot
scenarios.expected: A 2003-era journal tagged 2651 is evaluated against contemporaneous approved chart, not the 2015 meaning; ambiguous 2003 text quarantines unapproved mapping.

scenarios.title: 2651 mapping under 2015 snapshot
scenarios.expected: A 2015+ transaction uses 2651 public securities only after signed institutional chart approval and verified applicability.

scenarios.title: 2652 mapping reversal
scenarios.expected: A change of label between source versions never silently reclassifies existing posted securities or rewrites old financial reports.

scenarios.title: 312 vs 322 conflict
scenarios.expected: A request to auto-generate short-term sensitive account 312 from 2015 art.8(d) is rejected pending approved correction; 322 children cannot be parented under 312.

scenarios.title: Effective date versus signature
scenarios.expected: The system stores 2018-01-01 as stated regulatory effective date and 2018-01-16 as decision date without creating backdated journals or policy activation.

scenarios.title: Superseded rule reference
scenarios.expected: A 2015 PCEC commentary reference to R-2014/01 cannot override the 2018 repeal; no automatic 2014 classification policy after valid successor applicability.

scenarios.title: Unverified I-2002 text
scenarios.expected: An issuer annual report alone cannot create executable 2002 chart mappings.

scenarios.title: General provisions
scenarios.expected: At 2% stock threshold, an annual 0.5% charge cannot be blindly posted without applying current 2018 art.17 conditions and approved policy.

scenarios.title: Counterparty contagion
scenarios.expected: Credit-risk classification decisions (2018 art.10) cannot mutate GL balances; all resulting entries require independent Accounting Core authorization.

scenarios.title: Correction after period closure
scenarios.expected: A proposed retroactive change posts neither into a sealed accounting period nor by editing historical journal rows; approved correction workflow produces new traceable journals.

scenarios.title: External unknown settlement
scenarios.expected: A settlement request with unknown external result remains unresolved; retry does not duplicate posting, claim finality, or invent liquidity.

scenarios.title: Regulatory evidence revocation
scenarios.expected: Revoking an instrument approval quarantines pending activation while preserving original source, decision, actor, timestamp, and historical report reproducibility.
